title: Transfinder GPS Spoof — Bus 104 on Route 22

lines.text: Dispatch, Driver 104 on Route 22. Bus 104 is running 12 minutes behind schedule. The GPS tracker is showing a fake location near Salem, but the bus is actually at the stop at 3rd and Main. Can you check the Transfinder feed?
Driver 104, we see your location on Transfinder as 10 miles west of town. Stand by for verification.
Roger, Dispatch. Bus 104 is still at 3rd and Main. I’ve got five students on board and the stop is clear. This isn’t right.

instructorNote: Noise inject; the Transportation Branch Director should triage the GPS spoof and begin verifying fleet data integrity.
